item_name: Rothco CSI Deluxe Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s CSI Deluxe Low Profile Cap is made from a durable 100% brushed cotton twill, featuring a raised 3-D embroidered “CSI” text on the front panel as well as the brim. This hat also features a hook and loop closure in back for adjustability.
